_comment: Copy to style.json to make it this server's default look. Read at submit time, so an edit applies to the next job with no restart. Every key is optional; anything you leave out keeps its built-in default, and a malformed file falls back to the defaults rather than failing the job. Unknown keys are ignored.

hook._comment: Burns the viral_hook_text the AI already writes for every clip. Off unless you set enabled. duration_seconds: null shows it for the whole clip. style: classic | dark | yellow | red | outline | outline_yellow. size: S | M | L.
